_about: Historical natural-history plates used as the figure for a species, in place of the drawn study. Every entry records the artist, the work, the year of publication, the licence and the source file, so the public-domain claim can be checked. Only works published in 1928 or earlier are used. Species with no entry here fall back to the drawn plate in assets/sketches.js.
